meta.name: central-dome-right-wing-wireframe-labeled

mapPrototype2Reference.interpretation: Right wing is the longer Chemistry/Alchemy/Lab side in column J, extending farther south from the H6 dome core.

meta.designIntent: Separate right wing for the Central Complex. Based on map-prototype-2 and the snowy courtyard photo, this is the longer east-side Chemistry/Alchemy/Lab wing around J5-J3/J7: repeated inward-facing bays, regular two-story windows, a continuous plinth/cornice, and a heavier far-end pavilion.

photoInterpretation.courtyardPhoto: Snowy plaza view of the right wing: longer and more repetitive than the left wing, with many inward-facing bay divisions and a heavier terminal pavilion at the far end.
photoInterpretation.modelResponse: Adds the west/courtyard-facing repetitive bay rhythm and a stronger south/front terminal mass while retaining the longer map-derived Chemistry/Alchemy/Lab footprint.
